title: Newsroom newsletter panel: counts, lists, issues, approval, test send, delivery history
description: Administration panel backed by newsletter custom queries and mutations with group checks: subscriber counts, issues and actions (approve for a time, cancel, stop, test send to own address), delivery, bounce and complaint history, pause and resume, admin erasure and CSV export.
